_meta.purpose: Design-only architecture plan mapping passkey-first authentication, KYC/CDD/EDD proofing, Cedar policy decisions, tenant/compliance-pack state, data classes, audit evidence, consent, retention, residency, and accreditation packets into existing Oyatie PDP, evidence, and tenant contracts. No service implementation and no CLI surface are introduced by this artifact.

usable_findings: KISA/KMCC/KCC identity-verification designation has 87 review items and requires official PDF table extraction before row-level implementation.
ISMS-P requires at least two months of operated management-system evidence before application, has three-year validity, annual surveillance, renewal lead time, and remediation windows.
CSAP evidence is document plus on-site assessment, includes annual post-management/renewal cadence, and must be modeled as cloud-control-plane evidence rather than ad-hoc service code.
Korean IoT security certification has seven control domains and matters only when Oyatie ships identity/KYC device or edge-authenticator hardware/software surfaces.

Passkeys/WebAuthn are the phishing-resistant account credential, but do not replace statutory identity-proofing evidence. Korean legacy verification methods are proofing evidence, not steady-state authentication UX.
source_authorities.gating_gap: Exact KISA 87-row, ISMS-P checklist, CSAP checklist, and IoT guide rows must be machine-extracted with source URL, version, date, hash, Korean text, and normalized control ids before blocker-grade row policies are authored.

usable_findings: WebAuthn Level 3/passkeys are the primary strong-auth credential.
TOTP is recovery/fallback only; SMS OTP, email-only auth, security questions, and weak push are forbidden.
Regulated packs require direct attestation plus AAGUID allowlists; critical operations require FIDO-MDS3 L2+ hardware-key posture.
W3C WebAuthn milestone 27 is titled L4 (First Published Working Draft), with the first-public-working-draft direction still open at authoring time.
Open Level 4 milestone work at authoring includes immediate mediation UI, alternative error codes, sign extensions, CTAP2.3 virtual-authenticator version strings, and ML-DSA test vectors.

REGID-002 may design extension points conscious of Level 4 direction, but blocker-grade policy, KYC evidence, readiness, and certification claims must remain grounded in WebAuthn Level 3 and implemented client/authenticator support until Level 4 stabilizes.
ACR classes are routine, elevated, sensitive, and critical.
Mutating and regulated operations declare acr_required in policy/API metadata.
Every ACR grant emits IdentityStepUpGranted audit evidence.
AuthorizationRequest carries request_id, tenant_id, principal, action, resource, context, and min_policy_version.
AuthorizationResponse carries decision_id, request_id, decision, policy_version, determining_policy_ids, and obligations.
DecisionAuditRecord carries tenant_id, principal, action, resource, decision, policy_version, determining_policy_ids, and cache_hit.
AuditChainCedarPdp fail-closes when the PDP decision cannot be durably appended to the signed audit-chain ledger.
Tenant rows already carry jurisdiction, compliance_packs, kyc_status, trust_score, eligible_capabilities, audit_streams, and data-residency attributes.
kyc_status has not_required, pending_documents, in_review, verified, verified_enhanced, rejected, expired, and suspended states.
compliance_packs activation is explicitly gated by eligible_capabilities plus KYB.

Pack bundles already include Cedar fragments, audit-chain requirements, data-class extensions, retention rules, consent requirements, jurisdiction overlays, DPIA template ids, breach-notification workflows, and regulator references.
Pack-defined data classes are namespaced as data_class_extensions and pack rules cannot relax below regulator minimums.

northstar.statement: Keep account access passkey-first and phishing-resistant while treating statutory identity proofing, due diligence, and accreditation evidence as policy/evidence overlays over tenant, Cedar, audit-chain, and compliance-pack contracts.
passkeys_are: attestation source for regulated-pack credential posture
passkeys_are_not: a substitute for statutory KYC/CDD/EDD proofing
a replacement for KISA/KMCC 본인확인기관 designation evidence
a replacement for PCI, US CIP/CDD, EU AMLR, or GDPR records
northstar.legacy_regional_methods_role: KR 본인확인, US CIP document checks, EU eIDAS/eID/AML proofing, and PCI merchant due diligence are modeled as proofing/evidence events that may upgrade kyc_status/trust_score and satisfy compliance-pack obligations; they do not become the primary sign-in UX.

canonical_control_plane_flow.name: passkey_session_established
canonical_control_plane_flow.description: Principal signs in with passkey/WebAuthn. OIDC session carries acr and acr_event_at. Regulated tenants require attested AAGUID posture according to active compliance packs.

canonical_control_plane_flow.name: proofing_case_opened
canonical_control_plane_flow.contract_anchor: tenant kyc_status + KYB/KYC IP-018/IP-024 planned routes
canonical_control_plane_flow.description: Tenant or subject opens a proofing case through an API. The case records jurisdiction, tenant audience type, requested capability, active compliance packs, proofing tier, and source-control-row ids.

canonical_control_plane_flow.name: cedar_preflight
canonical_control_plane_flow.description: PEP asks Cedar whether the principal may start, upload, verify, decide, or export evidence. Context carries acr, proofing_tier, active_pack_ids, jurisdiction, data_classes, consent_refs, residency_target, source_row_ids, and evidence_freshness.

canonical_control_plane_flow.name: evidence_ingested
canonical_control_plane_flow.description: Evidence objects are ingested by API, data-classed, tenant-scoped, residency-pinned, and linked to audit-chain seals. Raw sensitive documents are stored in the evidence/object substrate; PDP and tenant rows reference handles only.

canonical_control_plane_flow.name: proofing_decision
canonical_control_plane_flow.description: Domain decision upgrades or refuses kyc_status and eligible_capabilities. Standard CDD maps to verified; EDD maps to verified_enhanced; expired/stale source evidence returns expired or suspended.

canonical_control_plane_flow.name: pack_or_capability_activation
canonical_control_plane_flow.description: Cedar gates compliance-pack activation and tenant capability activation against proofing state, consent, retention, residency, cell certification, accreditation packet completeness, and active policy version freshness.

canonical_control_plane_flow.name: accreditation_packet_export
canonical_control_plane_flow.description: Ops-compliance exports regulator/auditor packets as API/query results containing source row ids, evidence object handles, audit-chain decision ids, retention timers, consent refs, and residency/cell attestations.

authentication_acr_ladder.kyc_policy_role: Read-only onboarding and low-risk self-service where active packs do not require stronger proofing.
Default floor for starting proofing, uploading proofing documents, and mutating own tenant data.
minimum_evidence: AAGUID metadata when pack requires attestation

authentication_acr_ladder.kyc_policy_role: Floor for manual proofing decisions, evidence export, pack activation, consent override, sanctions/PEP review, and payment/financial data access.
Floor for KISA/PCI/accreditation packet publication, tenant deletion, residency-policy mutation, regulator export-all, or pack-signing-key rotation.

proofing_ladder.cedar_effect: Deny regulated capability activation and regulated data access unless an active pack explicitly exempts the tenant class.

minimum_evidence: identity document or authoritative ID assertion handle
proofing_ladder.cedar_effect: Permit standard tenant activation and non-regulated capabilities when compliance packs, consent, and residency checks pass.

minimum_evidence: source-of-funds or UBO evidence where applicable
manual review decision with sensitive/critical ACR
proofing_ladder.cedar_effect: Permit high-risk capability activation only with fresh EDD evidence and deny when screening status is hit, stale, or unresolved.
Permit accreditation packet publication, regulated pack activation, and regulator/auditor exports only when every required source row has current evidence or an explicit unknown/waiver state.

validation_plan: This artifact must remain valid JSON.
No product source code, generated JSON, CLI docs, or service implementation should be changed by REGID-002.
Future schema/API slices must add targeted tests for their own artifacts; this architecture plan itself is validated by JSON parse and independent review.
Every blocker-grade policy or pack row must trace to REGID-001 or successor source rows with URL/version/hash before implementation.

WebAuthn Level 4 working-draft direction may inform extension points only; no Level 4-dependent requirement is blocker-grade until the relevant feature is standardized and available in supported clients/authenticators.
non_goals: Do not implement a KYC service in this task.
Do not add a CLI for proofing, evidence upload, or accreditation packet export.
Do not hand-transcribe Korean PDF table rows as authoritative source rows.
Do not weaken passkey-first authentication to copy regional legacy verification UX.
Do not claim WebAuthn Level 4 readiness or make Level 4 draft features mandatory in REGID-002.
Do not store raw proofing documents in PDP context, logs, metrics, or tenant rows.
